Definition: perhaps from G4535 (through the idea of quavering or reverberation); a trumpet:--trump(-et).
BiblicalUsage: The sense of sálpinx is perhaps from G4535 (through the idea of quavering or reverberation); a trumpet. In 1 Corinthians 14:8, we read, "…trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare…"; in 1 Thessalonians 4:16, "For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven…". You hear it again in Hebrews 12:19 — "…a trumpet, and the voice of words; which…" — and in Matthew 24:31, "…shall send his angels with a great sound…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word sálpinx is in the Bible for a reason, and it carries weight far beyond its size in the text. I hold that sálpinx still speaks, because the God who spoke then has not changed.
